entities.label: Users

fields.expression: CASE WHEN u.is_active = 1 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END
fields.default: CASE WHEN u.is_active = 1 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END

entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='User') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(u.user_id AS VARCHAR) AS UserID,
    TRY_CAST(LEFT(CAST(u.email AS TEXT), STRPOS(u.email || '@', '@') - 1) AS VARCHAR) AS Loginname,
    TRY_CAST(CONCAT_WS(' ', u.first_name, u.last_name) AS VARCHAR) AS FullName,
    TRY_CAST(u.email AS VARCHAR) AS Email,
    TRY_CAST(u.role AS VARCHAR) AS Role,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN u.is_active = 1 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS VARCHAR) AS Status,
    TRY_CAST(0 AS BOOLEAN) AS IsDeleted,
    TRY_CAST(0 AS BOOLEAN) AS IsArchived
FROM {{ ref('mid_users') }} AS u

entities.label: Clients

fields.expression: CASE WHEN NOT c.address_line_1 IS NULL THEN c.client_id END
fields.default: CASE WHEN NOT c.address_line_1 IS NULL THEN c.client_id END

fields.expression: CASE WHEN c.status = 'deleted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
fields.default: CASE WHEN c.status = 'deleted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Company') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(c.client_id AS VARCHAR) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(LEFT(CAST(c.company_name AS TEXT), 50) AS VARCHAR) AS CompanyName,
    TRY_CAST(c.industry AS VARCHAR) AS Industry,
    TRY_CAST(LEFT(CAST(c.website AS TEXT), 50) AS VARCHAR) AS Website,
    TRY_CAST(c.phone AS VARCHAR) AS Telephone,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN NOT c.address_line_1 IS NULL THEN c.client_id END AS VARCHAR) AS LocationID,
    TRY_CAST('Client' AS VARCHAR) AS Type,
    TRY_CAST(c.owner_user_id AS VARCHAR) AS Company_OwnerID,
    TRY_CAST(c.owner_user_id AS VARCHAR) AS AddedBy,
    TRY_CAST(c.created_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS AddedDate,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN c.status = 'deleted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BOOLEAN) AS Isdeleted,
    TRY_CAST(0 AS BOOLEAN) AS IsArchive
FROM {{ ref('mid_clients') }} AS c

entities.label: Client locations
entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='CompanyLocation') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(c.client_id AS VARCHAR) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(c.client_id AS VARCHAR) AS CompanyID,
    TRY_CAST(c.address_line_1 AS VARCHAR) AS AddressLine1,
    TRY_CAST(c.address_line_2 AS VARCHAR) AS AddressLine2,
    TRY_CAST(c.city AS VARCHAR) AS City,
    TRY_CAST(c.postcode AS VARCHAR) AS PostCode,
    TRY_CAST(c.country AS VARCHAR) AS Country,
    TRY_CAST(c.created_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS AddedAt
FROM {{ ref('mid_clients') }} AS c
WHERE (NOT c.address_line_1 IS NULL)

entities.label: Contacts

fields.expression: CASE WHEN ct.status = 'inactive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
fields.default: CASE WHEN ct.status = 'inactive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Contact') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(ct.contact_id AS VARCHAR) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(ct.first_name AS VARCHAR) AS FirstName,
    TRY_CAST(ct.last_name AS VARCHAR) AS LastName,
    TRY_CAST(ct.client_id AS VARCHAR) AS CompanyID,
    TRY_CAST(ct.email AS VARCHAR) AS Email,
    TRY_CAST(COALESCE(ct.phone, ct.mobile) AS VARCHAR) AS Phone,
    TRY_CAST(LEFT(CAST(ct.job_title AS TEXT), 50) AS VARCHAR) AS PositionTitle,
    TRY_CAST('Client contact' AS VARCHAR) AS Contacttype,
    TRY_CAST(ct.owner_user_id AS VARCHAR) AS ContactOwnerID,
    TRY_CAST(0 AS BOOLEAN) AS IsDeleted,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN ct.status = 'inactive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BOOLEAN) AS IsArchived,
    TRY_CAST(ct.owner_user_id AS VARCHAR) AS AddedBy,
    TRY_CAST(ct.created_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS AddedAt
FROM {{ ref('mid_contacts') }} AS ct
WHERE (NOT ct.client_id IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_clients') }} AS x WHERE x.client_id = ct.client_id))

entities.label: Candidates

fields.expression: CASE WHEN NOT ca.email IS NULL THEN TRY_CAST(ca.candidate_id AS INT) * 10 + 1 END
fields.default: CASE WHEN NOT ca.email IS NULL THEN TRY_CAST(ca.candidate_id AS INT) * 10 + 1 END

entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Applicant') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(ca.candidate_id AS VARCHAR) AS ApplicantID,
    TRY_CAST(ca.first_name AS VARCHAR) AS FirstName,
    TRY_CAST(ca.last_name AS VARCHAR) AS LastName,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN NOT ca.email IS NULL THEN TRY_CAST(ca.candidate_id AS INT) * 10 + 1 END AS INTEGER) AS ApplicantCommsID,
    TRY_CAST(ca.status AS VARCHAR) AS Status,
    TRY_CAST(LEFT(CAST(ca.current_job_title AS TEXT), 50) AS VARCHAR) AS JobTitle,
    TRY_CAST(ca.source AS VARCHAR) AS Source,
    TRY_CAST(1 AS BOOLEAN) AS Active,
    TRY_CAST(ca.owner_user_id AS VARCHAR) AS ApplicantOwner,
    TRY_CAST(ca.owner_user_id AS VARCHAR) AS AddedBy,
    TRY_CAST(ca.created_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS AddedAt,
    TRY_CAST(0 AS BOOLEAN) AS Deleted
FROM {{ ref('mid_candidates') }} AS ca

entities.label: Candidate email & mobile
entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Comms') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(ca.candidate_id AS INT) * 10 + 1 AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(ca.candidate_id AS VARCHAR) AS ObjectID,
    TRY_CAST('Applicant' AS VARCHAR) AS ObjectType,
    TRY_CAST(ca.email AS VARCHAR) AS Value,
    TRY_CAST('Email' AS VARCHAR) AS Type,
    TRY_CAST(0 AS BOOLEAN) AS Deleted,
    TRY_CAST(ca.owner_user_id AS VARCHAR) AS AddedBy
FROM {{ ref('mid_candidates') }} AS ca
WHERE (NOT ca.email IS NULL)
UNION ALL
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(ca.candidate_id AS INT) * 10 + 2 AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(ca.candidate_id AS VARCHAR) AS ObjectID,
    TRY_CAST('Applicant' AS VARCHAR) AS ObjectType,
    TRY_CAST(ca.mobile AS VARCHAR) AS Value,
    TRY_CAST('Mobile' AS VARCHAR) AS Type,
    TRY_CAST(0 AS BOOLEAN) AS Deleted,
    TRY_CAST(ca.owner_user_id AS VARCHAR) AS AddedBy
FROM {{ ref('mid_candidates') }} AS ca
WHERE (NOT ca.mobile IS NULL)

entities.label: Jobs

fields.expression: CASE WHEN j.status = 'filled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
fields.default: CASE WHEN j.status = 'filled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

fields.expression: CASE WHEN j.status IN ('filled', 'cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
fields.default: CASE WHEN j.status IN ('filled', 'cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

fields.expression: CASE WHEN j.status = 'deleted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
fields.default: CASE WHEN j.status = 'deleted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Position') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(j.job_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(LEFT(CAST(j.title AS TEXT), 50) AS VARCHAR) AS PositionName,
    TRY_CAST(j.client_id AS VARCHAR) AS CompanyID,
    TRY_CAST(j.contact_id AS VARCHAR) AS ContactID,
    TRY_CAST(j.status AS VARCHAR) AS Status,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN j.status = 'filled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BOOLEAN) AS Filled,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN j.status IN ('filled', 'cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BOOLEAN) AS Closed,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN j.status = 'deleted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BOOLEAN) AS Deleted,
    TRY_CAST(j.rate AS DOUBLE) AS PositionChargeRate,
    TRY_CAST(CAST(j.salary_min AS VARCHAR) AS VARCHAR) AS Salary,
    TRY_CAST('GBP' AS VARCHAR) AS Currency,
    TRY_CAST(j.opened_at AS DATE) AS DateBegins,
    TRY_CAST(j.closed_at AS DATE) AS DateEnds,
    TRY_CAST(j.owner_user_id AS VARCHAR) AS Addedby,
    TRY_CAST(j.owner_user_id AS VARCHAR) AS PositionOwnerID
FROM {{ ref('mid_jobs') }} AS j
WHERE (NOT j.client_id IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_clients') }} AS x WHERE x.client_id = j.client_id))

entities.label: Placements
entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Placements') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(pl.placement_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(pl.candidate_id AS VARCHAR) AS ApplicantID,
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(pl.job_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS PositionID,
    TRY_CAST(j.client_id AS VARCHAR) AS CompanyID,
    TRY_CAST(pl.placement_type AS VARCHAR) AS EmploymentType,
    TRY_CAST(pl.start_date AS DATE) AS StartDate,
    TRY_CAST(pl.end_date AS DATE) AS EndDate,
    TRY_CAST(pl.fee AS DOUBLE) AS Fee,
    TRY_CAST('Placed' AS VARCHAR) AS Status,
    TRY_CAST(pl.owner_user_id AS VARCHAR) AS OwnerID
FROM {{ ref('mid_placements') }} AS pl
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('mid_jobs') }} AS j ON j.job_id = pl.job_id
WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_jobs') }} AS x WHERE x.job_id = pl.job_id AND NOT x.client_id IS NULL))
  AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_candidates') }} AS x WHERE x.candidate_id = pl.candidate_id))

entities.label: Notes

fields.expression: CASE WHEN n.entity_type = 'candidate' THEN n.entity_id END
fields.default: CASE WHEN n.entity_type = 'candidate' THEN n.entity_id END

fields.expression: CASE WHEN n.entity_type = 'client' THEN n.entity_id END
fields.default: CASE WHEN n.entity_type = 'client' THEN n.entity_id END

fields.expression: CASE WHEN n.entity_type = 'job' THEN TRY_CAST(n.entity_id AS INT) END
fields.default: CASE WHEN n.entity_type = 'job' THEN TRY_CAST(n.entity_id AS INT) END

fields.expression: CASE WHEN n.entity_type = 'contact' THEN n.entity_id END
fields.default: CASE WHEN n.entity_type = 'contact' THEN n.entity_id END

entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Notes') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(n.note_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(n.body AS VARCHAR) AS Text,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN n.entity_type = 'candidate' THEN n.entity_id END AS VARCHAR) AS ApplicantID,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN n.entity_type = 'client' THEN n.entity_id END AS VARCHAR) AS CompanyID,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN n.entity_type = 'job' THEN TRY_CAST(n.entity_id AS INT) END AS INTEGER) AS PositionID,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN n.entity_type = 'contact' THEN n.entity_id END AS VARCHAR) AS ContactID,
    TRY_CAST(0 AS BOOLEAN) AS Deleted,
    TRY_CAST(n.created_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS AddedAt,
    TRY_CAST(n.author_user_id AS VARCHAR) AS UserID
FROM {{ ref('mid_notes') }} AS n
WHERE ((n.entity_type = 'candidate' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_candidates') }} AS x WHERE x.candidate_id = n.entity_id)) OR (n.entity_type = 'contact' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_contacts') }} AS x WHERE x.contact_id = n.entity_id AND NOT x.client_id IS NULL)) OR (n.entity_type = 'job' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_jobs') }} AS x WHERE x.job_id = n.entity_id AND NOT x.client_id IS NULL)) OR (n.entity_type = 'client' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_clients') }} AS x WHERE x.client_id = n.entity_id)))

entities.label: Activities
entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Task') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(a.activity_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(a.activity_type AS VARCHAR) AS TaskType,
    TRY_CAST(a.user_id AS VARCHAR) AS OwnerUserID,
    TRY_CAST(LEFT(CAST(a.subject AS TEXT), 50) AS VARCHAR) AS Subject,
    TRY_CAST(a.subject AS VARCHAR) AS Note,
    TRY_CAST('Completed' AS VARCHAR) AS Status,
    TRY_CAST(CAST(a.occurred_at AS DATE) AS DATE) AS StartDate,
    TRY_CAST(1 AS BOOLEAN) AS Completed,
    TRY_CAST(a.occurred_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS AddedAt
FROM {{ ref('mid_activities') }} AS a
UNION ALL
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(100000 + TRY_CAST(iv.interview_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST('Interview' AS VARCHAR) AS TaskType,
    TRY_CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS OwnerUserID,
    TRY_CAST('Interview feedback' AS VARCHAR) AS Subject,
    TRY_CAST(iv.feedback AS VARCHAR) AS Note,
    TRY_CAST('Completed' AS VARCHAR) AS Status,
    TRY_CAST(CAST(iv.interview_date AS DATE) AS DATE) AS StartDate,
    TRY_CAST(1 AS BOOLEAN) AS Completed,
    TRY_CAST(iv.created_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS AddedAt
FROM {{ ref('mid_interviews') }} AS iv

entities.label: Activity links
entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='TaskItem') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(a.activity_id AS INT) * 10 + 1 AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(a.activity_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS TaskID,
    TRY_CAST(a.candidate_id AS VARCHAR) AS ObjectID,
    TRY_CAST('Applicant' AS VARCHAR) AS ObjectType,
    TRY_CAST(a.occurred_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS AddedAt
FROM {{ ref('mid_activities') }} AS a
WHERE (NOT a.candidate_id IS NULL)
  AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_candidates') }} AS x WHERE x.candidate_id = a.candidate_id))
UNION ALL
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(a.activity_id AS INT) * 10 + 2 AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(a.activity_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS TaskID,
    TRY_CAST(a.contact_id AS VARCHAR) AS ObjectID,
    TRY_CAST('Contact' AS VARCHAR) AS ObjectType,
    TRY_CAST(a.occurred_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS AddedAt
FROM {{ ref('mid_activities') }} AS a
WHERE (NOT a.contact_id IS NULL)
  AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_contacts') }} AS x WHERE x.contact_id = a.contact_id AND NOT x.client_id IS NULL))
UNION ALL
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(a.activity_id AS INT) * 10 + 3 AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(a.activity_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS TaskID,
    TRY_CAST(a.job_id AS VARCHAR) AS ObjectID,
    TRY_CAST('Position' AS VARCHAR) AS ObjectType,
    TRY_CAST(a.occurred_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS AddedAt
FROM {{ ref('mid_activities') }} AS a
WHERE (NOT a.job_id IS NULL)
UNION ALL
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(1000000 + TRY_CAST(iv.interview_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(100000 + TRY_CAST(iv.interview_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS TaskID,
    TRY_CAST(iv.candidate_id AS VARCHAR) AS ObjectID,
    TRY_CAST('Applicant' AS VARCHAR) AS ObjectType,
    TRY_CAST(iv.created_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS AddedAt
FROM {{ ref('mid_interviews') }} AS iv
WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_candidates') }} AS x WHERE x.candidate_id = iv.candidate_id))

entities.label: Documents

fields.expression: CASE WHEN d.document_id LIKE 'CV%' THEN 100000 + TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(d.document_id, 3, 20) AS INT) ELSE TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(d.document_id, 2, 20) AS INT) END
fields.default: CASE WHEN d.document_id LIKE 'CV%' THEN 100000 + TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(d.document_id, 3, 20) AS INT) ELSE TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(d.document_id, 2, 20) AS INT) END

entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Attachments') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN d.document_id LIKE 'CV%' THEN 100000 + TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(d.document_id, 3, 20) AS INT) ELSE TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(d.document_id, 2, 20) AS INT) END AS INTEGER) AS AttachmentID,
    TRY_CAST(d.entity_type AS VARCHAR) AS AttachmentType,
    TRY_CAST(LEFT(CAST(d.file_name AS TEXT), 50) AS VARCHAR) AS AttachmentName,
    TRY_CAST(LEFT(CAST(d.storage_path AS TEXT), 50) AS VARCHAR) AS FilePath,
    TRY_CAST(d.file_type AS VARCHAR) AS FileType,
    TRY_CAST(d.uploaded_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS UploadedAt,
    TRY_CAST(0 AS BOOLEAN) AS IsPrimary,
    TRY_CAST(0 AS BOOLEAN) AS IsArchived,
    TRY_CAST(0 AS BOOLEAN) AS IsDeleted
FROM {{ ref('mid_documents') }} AS d
WHERE ((d.entity_type = 'candidate' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_candidates') }} AS x WHERE x.candidate_id = d.entity_id)) OR (d.entity_type = 'contact' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_contacts') }} AS x WHERE x.contact_id = d.entity_id AND NOT x.client_id IS NULL)) OR (d.entity_type = 'job' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_jobs') }} AS x WHERE x.job_id = d.entity_id AND NOT x.client_id IS NULL)) OR (d.entity_type = 'client' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_clients') }} AS x WHERE x.client_id = d.entity_id)))

entities.label: Departments
entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Department') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(d.department_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(d.name AS VARCHAR) AS Name,
    TRY_CAST(d.created_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS AddedAt,
    TRY_CAST(d.updated_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS UpdatedAt
FROM {{ ref('mid_departments') }} AS d

entities.label: Skill categories
entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='SkillCategory') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(sc.category_id AS VARCHAR) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(sc.name AS VARCHAR) AS CategoryName,
    TRY_CAST(sc.deleted AS BOOLEAN) AS Deleted
FROM {{ ref('mid_skill_categories') }} AS sc

entities.label: Skills

fields.expression: CASE WHEN sk.deleted = 1 THEN 'Inactive' ELSE 'Active' END
fields.default: CASE WHEN sk.deleted = 1 THEN 'Inactive' ELSE 'Active' END

entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Skills') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(sk.skill_id AS VARCHAR) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(sk.name AS VARCHAR) AS SkillName,
    TRY_CAST(sk.category_id AS VARCHAR) AS SkillCategoryID,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN sk.deleted = 1 THEN 'Inactive' ELSE 'Active' END AS VARCHAR) AS Status
FROM {{ ref('mid_skills') }} AS sk

entities.label: Job types

inserts.source: (SELECT DISTINCT employment_type FROM mid__Jobs WHERE NOT employment_type IS NULL) AS j

fields.expression: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY j.employment_type NULLS FIRST)
fields.default: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY j.employment_type NULLS FIRST)

entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='PositionType') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY j.employment_type NULLS FIRST) AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(UPPER(LEFT(CAST(j.employment_type AS TEXT), 1)) || SUBSTRING(j.employment_type, 2, 50) AS VARCHAR) AS Type
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT employment_type FROM {{ ref('mid_jobs') }} WHERE NOT employment_type IS NULL) AS j

entities.label: Job details

fields.expression: CASE WHEN j.rate_unit = 'day' THEN 'Daily' WHEN NOT j.salary_min IS NULL THEN 'Annual' END
fields.default: CASE WHEN j.rate_unit = 'day' THEN 'Daily' WHEN NOT j.salary_min IS NULL THEN 'Annual' END

entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Position_Details') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(j.job_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(j.job_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS PositionID,
    TRY_CAST(j.description AS VARCHAR) AS Requirement,
    TRY_CAST(j.location AS VARCHAR) AS Location,
    TRY_CAST(j.closed_at AS DATE) AS ClosingDate,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN j.rate_unit = 'day' THEN 'Daily' WHEN NOT j.salary_min IS NULL THEN 'Annual' END AS VARCHAR) AS PayFrequency,
    TRY_CAST(j.owner_user_id AS VARCHAR) AS AddedBy
FROM {{ ref('mid_jobs') }} AS j
WHERE (NOT j.client_id IS NULL)

entities.label: Applications

fields.expression: CASE WHEN a.stage IN ('placed', 'rejected') OR a.deleted = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
fields.default: CASE WHEN a.stage IN ('placed', 'rejected') OR a.deleted = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Position_Applicant') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(a.application_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(a.job_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS PositionID,
    TRY_CAST(a.candidate_id AS VARCHAR) AS ApplicantID,
    TRY_CAST(a.client_id AS VARCHAR) AS CompanyID,
    TRY_CAST(CAST(a.applied_at AS DATE) AS DATE) AS ApplicationDate,
    TRY_CAST(UPPER(LEFT(CAST(a.stage AS TEXT), 1)) || SUBSTRING(a.stage, 2, 50) AS VARCHAR) AS StatusTxt,
    TRY_CAST(a.owner_user_id AS VARCHAR) AS AddedBy,
    TRY_CAST(a.applied_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS AddedAt,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN a.stage IN ('placed', 'rejected') OR a.deleted = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS BOOLEAN) AS Active
FROM {{ ref('mid_applications') }} AS a
WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_jobs') }} AS x WHERE x.job_id = a.job_id AND NOT x.client_id IS NULL))
  AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_candidates') }} AS x WHERE x.candidate_id = a.candidate_id))

entities.label: Shortlists
entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Shortlist') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(a.application_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(a.job_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS PositionID,
    TRY_CAST(a.candidate_id AS VARCHAR) AS ApplicantID,
    TRY_CAST(CAST(a.applied_at AS DATE) AS DATE) AS ShortlistedDate,
    TRY_CAST(UPPER(LEFT(CAST(a.stage AS TEXT), 1)) || SUBSTRING(a.stage, 2, 50) AS VARCHAR) AS Status,
    TRY_CAST(a.owner_user_id AS VARCHAR) AS AddedBy,
    TRY_CAST(a.applied_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS AddedAt
FROM {{ ref('mid_applications') }} AS a
WHERE (a.stage IN ('screening', 'interview', 'offer'))
  AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_jobs') }} AS x WHERE x.job_id = a.job_id AND NOT x.client_id IS NULL))
  AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_candidates') }} AS x WHERE x.candidate_id = a.candidate_id))

entities.label: Offers

fields.expression: CASE WHEN a.stage = 'placed' THEN TRY_CAST(a.application_id AS INT) END
fields.default: CASE WHEN a.stage = 'placed' THEN TRY_CAST(a.application_id AS INT) END

fields.expression: CASE WHEN a.stage = 'placed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
fields.default: CASE WHEN a.stage = 'placed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Offer') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(a.application_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN a.stage = 'placed' THEN TRY_CAST(a.application_id AS INT) END AS INTEGER) AS PlacementID,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN a.stage = 'placed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BOOLEAN) AS Accepted,
    TRY_CAST(a.employment_type AS VARCHAR) AS Terms,
    TRY_CAST(a.owner_user_id AS VARCHAR) AS RecruiterID
FROM {{ ref('mid_applications') }} AS a
WHERE (a.stage IN ('offer', 'placed'))
  AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_jobs') }} AS x WHERE x.job_id = a.job_id AND NOT x.client_id IS NULL))
  AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_candidates') }} AS x WHERE x.candidate_id = a.candidate_id))

entities.label: Deals
entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Deal') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(pl.placement_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(pl.placement_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS PlacementID,
    TRY_CAST(pl.owner_user_id AS VARCHAR) AS RecruiterID,
    TRY_CAST(j.client_id AS VARCHAR) AS CompanyID,
    TRY_CAST(pl.start_date AS DATE) AS DealDate,
    TRY_CAST(pl.placement_type AS VARCHAR) AS DealType,
    TRY_CAST(pl.fee AS DECIMAL(8,2)) AS DealValue
FROM {{ ref('mid_placements') }} AS pl
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('mid_jobs') }} AS j ON j.job_id = pl.job_id
WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_jobs') }} AS x WHERE x.job_id = pl.job_id AND NOT x.client_id IS NULL))
  AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_candidates') }} AS x WHERE x.candidate_id = pl.candidate_id))

entities.label: Deal stages
entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Deal_Stage') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(pl.placement_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(pl.placement_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS DealID,
    TRY_CAST('Won' AS VARCHAR) AS Stage
FROM {{ ref('mid_placements') }} AS pl
WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_jobs') }} AS x WHERE x.job_id = pl.job_id AND NOT x.client_id IS NULL))
  AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_candidates') }} AS x WHERE x.candidate_id = pl.candidate_id))

entities.label: Work history
entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Work_History') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(w.history_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(w.candidate_id AS VARCHAR) AS ApplicationID,
    TRY_CAST(LEFT(CAST(w.employer AS TEXT), 50) AS VARCHAR) AS CompanyName,
    TRY_CAST(LEFT(CAST(w.job_title AS TEXT), 50) AS VARCHAR) AS PositionTitle,
    TRY_CAST(w.start_date AS DATE) AS StartDate,
    TRY_CAST(w.end_date AS DATE) AS EndDate
FROM {{ ref('mid_work_history') }} AS w
WHERE (w.deleted = 0)
  AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_candidates') }} AS x WHERE x.candidate_id = w.candidate_id))

entities.label: References

fields.expression: CASE WHEN r.status = 'Received' THEN r.updated_at END
fields.default: CASE WHEN r.status = 'Received' THEN r.updated_at END

entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='References') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(r.reference_id AS VARCHAR) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(r.candidate_id AS VARCHAR) AS ApplicantID,
    TRY_CAST(r.full_name AS VARCHAR) AS Fullname,
    TRY_CAST(LEFT(CAST(r.job_title AS TEXT), 50) AS VARCHAR) AS PositionTitle,
    TRY_CAST(LEFT(CAST(r.company AS TEXT), 50) AS VARCHAR) AS CompanyName,
    TRY_CAST(r.relationship AS VARCHAR) AS Relationship,
    TRY_CAST(LEFT(CAST(r.email AS TEXT), 50) AS VARCHAR) AS Email,
    TRY_CAST(r.phone AS VARCHAR) AS PhoneContact,
    TRY_CAST('Employment' AS VARCHAR) AS ReferenceType,
    TRY_CAST(LEFT(CAST(r.status AS TEXT), 50) AS VARCHAR) AS Notes,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN r.status = 'Received' THEN r.updated_at END AS TIMESTAMP) AS VerifiedAt,
    TRY_CAST(r.created_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS AddedAt,
    TRY_CAST(r.updated_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS UpdatedAt
FROM {{ ref('mid_references') }} AS r
WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_candidates') }} AS x WHERE x.candidate_id = r.candidate_id))

entities.label: Candidate profiles
entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Employment_Details') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(cp.profile_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(cp.employment_type AS VARCHAR) AS Employment_Type,
    TRY_CAST(cp.candidate_id AS VARCHAR) AS ApplicantID,
    TRY_CAST(c.email_ok AS BOOLEAN) AS MarketingEmail,
    TRY_CAST(c.phone_ok AS BOOLEAN) AS MarketingPhone,
    TRY_CAST(c.text_ok AS BOOLEAN) AS MarketingText,
    TRY_CAST(LEFT(CAST(cp.bank AS TEXT), 50) AS VARCHAR) AS Bank,
    TRY_CAST(cp.sort_code AS VARCHAR) AS SortCode,
    TRY_CAST(cp.notes AS VARCHAR) AS Notes,
    TRY_CAST(cp.added_by AS VARCHAR) AS AddedBy,
    TRY_CAST(cp.created_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS AddedAt,
    TRY_CAST(cp.updated_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS UpdatedAt
FROM {{ ref('mid_candidate_profiles') }} AS cp
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('mid_consents') }} AS c ON c.person_id = cp.candidate_id
WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_candidates') }} AS x WHERE x.candidate_id = cp.candidate_id))

entities.label: Marketing consent

fields.expression: CASE WHEN c.email_ok = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
fields.default: CASE WHEN c.email_ok = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

fields.expression: CASE WHEN c.phone_ok = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
fields.default: CASE WHEN c.phone_ok = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

fields.expression: CASE WHEN c.text_ok = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
fields.default: CASE WHEN c.text_ok = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

fields.expression: CASE WHEN c.email_ok = 1 OR c.phone_ok = 1 OR c.text_ok = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
fields.default: CASE WHEN c.email_ok = 1 OR c.phone_ok = 1 OR c.text_ok = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

fields.expression: CASE WHEN c.email_ok = 0 AND c.phone_ok = 0 AND c.text_ok = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
fields.default: CASE WHEN c.email_ok = 0 AND c.phone_ok = 0 AND c.text_ok = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Marketing') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(c.consent_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(c.person_id AS VARCHAR) AS ApplicantID,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN c.email_ok = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS VARCHAR) AS Email,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN c.phone_ok = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS VARCHAR) AS Phone,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN c.text_ok = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS VARCHAR) AS Text,
    TRY_CAST(1 AS BOOLEAN) AS GDPRConsent,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN c.email_ok = 1 OR c.phone_ok = 1 OR c.text_ok = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BOOLEAN) AS OptIn,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN c.email_ok = 0 AND c.phone_ok = 0 AND c.text_ok = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BOOLEAN) AS OptOut,
    TRY_CAST(c.created_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS AddedAt,
    TRY_CAST(c.updated_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS UpdatedAt,
    TRY_CAST(c.added_by AS VARCHAR) AS AddedBy
FROM {{ ref('mid_consents') }} AS c
WHERE (c.person_id IN (SELECT candidate_id FROM {{ ref('mid_candidates') }}))

entities.label: Candidate sources

inserts.source: (SELECT DISTINCT source FROM mid__Candidates WHERE NOT source IS NULL) AS s

fields.expression: CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.source NULLS FIRST) AS VARCHAR)
fields.default: CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.source NULLS FIRST) AS VARCHAR)

entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Sources') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.source NULLS FIRST) AS VARCHAR) AS VARCHAR) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(UPPER(LEFT(CAST(s.source AS TEXT), 1)) || SUBSTRING(s.source, 2, 50) AS VARCHAR) AS Name
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT source FROM {{ ref('mid_candidates') }} WHERE NOT source IS NULL) AS s

entities.label: Currencies

inserts.source: (SELECT DISTINCT currency FROM mid__Invoices WHERE NOT currency IS NULL) AS cu

fields.expression: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cu.currency NULLS FIRST)
fields.default: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cu.currency NULLS FIRST)

entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Currencies') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cu.currency NULLS FIRST) AS INTEGER) AS CurrencyID,
    TRY_CAST(cu.currency AS VARCHAR) AS CurrencyCode
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT currency FROM {{ ref('mid_invoices') }} WHERE NOT currency IS NULL) AS cu

entities.label: Timesheets

fields.expression: (SELECT SUM(l.hours) FROM mid__TimesheetLines AS l WHERE l.timesheet_id = t.timesheet_id)
fields.default: (SELECT SUM(l.hours) FROM mid__TimesheetLines AS l WHERE l.timesheet_id = t.timesheet_id)

entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Timesheets') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(t.timesheet_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(t.start_date AS DATE) AS StartDate,
    TRY_CAST(t.end_date AS DATE) AS EndDate,
    TRY_CAST(t.pay_rate AS DECIMAL(8,2)) AS Payrate,
    TRY_CAST(t.charge_rate AS DECIMAL(8,2)) AS ChargeRate,
    TRY_CAST('GBP' AS VARCHAR) AS Currency,
    TRY_CAST(UPPER(LEFT(CAST(t.status AS TEXT), 1)) || SUBSTRING(t.status, 2, 50) AS VARCHAR) AS Status,
    TRY_CAST(t.timesheet_type AS VARCHAR) AS TimesheetType,
    TRY_CAST((SELECT SUM(l.hours) FROM {{ ref('mid_timesheet_lines') }} AS l WHERE l.timesheet_id = t.timesheet_id) AS DOUBLE) AS TotalWeekHours,
    TRY_CAST(t.approved_by AS VARCHAR) AS ApprovedBy,
    TRY_CAST(0 AS BOOLEAN) AS Deleted
FROM {{ ref('mid_timesheets') }} AS t

entities.label: Timesheet lines
entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='TimesheetActivity') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(l.line_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS ActivityID,
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(l.timesheet_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS TimesheetID,
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(l.candidate_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS AssocID,
    TRY_CAST(t.start_date AS DATE) AS TimesheetDate,
    TRY_CAST(l.hours AS DOUBLE) AS HoursWorked,
    TRY_CAST(t.status AS VARCHAR) AS Status,
    TRY_CAST(l.added_by AS VARCHAR) AS AddedBy,
    TRY_CAST(l.created_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS AddedAt
FROM {{ ref('mid_timesheet_lines') }} AS l
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('mid_timesheets') }} AS t ON t.timesheet_id = l.timesheet_id
WHERE (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_candidates') }} AS x WHERE x.candidate_id = l.candidate_id))

entities.label: Purchase orders

fields.expression: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY po.po_no NULLS FIRST)

entities.label: Invoices

fields.expression: (SELECT TRY_CAST(l.placement_id AS INT) FROM mid__InvoiceLines AS l WHERE l.invoice_id = inv.invoice_id AND NOT l.placement_id IS NULL LIMIT 1)
fields.default: (SELECT TRY_CAST(l.placement_id AS INT) FROM mid__InvoiceLines AS l WHERE l.invoice_id = inv.invoice_id AND NOT l.placement_id IS NULL LIMIT 1)

entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='Invoice') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(inv.invoice_id AS INT) AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(inv.invoice_type AS VARCHAR) AS Type,
    TRY_CAST(inv.invoice_no AS VARCHAR) AS InvoiceNo,
    TRY_CAST((SELECT TRY_CAST(l.placement_id AS INT) FROM {{ ref('mid_invoice_lines') }} AS l WHERE l.invoice_id = inv.invoice_id AND NOT l.placement_id IS NULL LIMIT 1) AS INTEGER) AS PlacementID,
    TRY_CAST(inv.net_amount AS DECIMAL(8,2)) AS Amount,
    TRY_CAST(inv.vat_amount AS DECIMAL(8,2)) AS TaxAmount,
    TRY_CAST(inv.currency AS VARCHAR) AS Currency,
    TRY_CAST(inv.invoice_date AS DATE) AS InvoiceDate,
    TRY_CAST(inv.due_date AS DATE) AS DueDate,
    TRY_CAST(UPPER(LEFT(CAST(inv.status AS TEXT), 1)) || SUBSTRING(inv.status, 2, 50) AS VARCHAR) AS Status,
    TRY_CAST(inv.description AS VARCHAR) AS Notes,
    TRY_CAST(inv.added_by AS VARCHAR) AS AddedBy
FROM {{ ref('mid_invoices') }} AS inv

entities.sql:
{{ config(alias='ApplicantAttachment') }}
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN d.document_id LIKE 'CV%' THEN 100000 + TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(d.document_id, 3, 20) AS INT) ELSE TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(d.document_id, 2, 20) AS INT) END AS INTEGER) AS ID,
    TRY_CAST(CASE WHEN d.document_id LIKE 'CV%' THEN 100000 + TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(d.document_id, 3, 20) AS INT) ELSE TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(d.document_id, 2, 20) AS INT) END AS INTEGER) AS AttachmentID,
    TRY_CAST(d.entity_id AS VARCHAR) AS ApplicantID,
    TRY_CAST(d.uploaded_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS AddedAt
FROM {{ ref('mid_documents') }} AS d
WHERE (d.entity_type = 'candidate')
  AND ((d.entity_type = 'candidate' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_candidates') }} AS x WHERE x.candidate_id = d.entity_id)) OR (d.entity_type = 'contact' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_contacts') }} AS x WHERE x.contact_id = d.entity_id AND NOT x.client_id IS NULL)) OR (d.entity_type = 'job' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_jobs') }} AS x WHERE x.job_id = d.entity_id AND NOT x.client_id IS NULL)) OR (d.entity_type = 'client' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM {{ ref('mid_clients') }} AS x WHERE x.client_id = d.entity_id)))
